high_level_description: This is a black-and-white photograph of Mahatma Gandhi, a prominent figure in Indian history known for his role in the Indian independence movement against British rule. The image captures Gandhi in a relaxed pose, wearing traditional attire that includes a white shawl draped over his shoulders. He is also wearing round glasses, which are characteristic of his appearance. The text overlay on the image reads: "I am prepared to die, but there is no cause for which I am prepared to kill.
